baseline.title: BenchmarkPython v0.1: source-bound atomic security questions

rules.title: Select the complete testcase init and module
rules.falsifier: The selected function is not the unique complete init function of the pinned testcase, or parsing is incomplete.

rules.title: Select XPath and response-body insertion endpoints

check.query:
((assignment left: (identifier) @_query_name right: (_) @query_expression) @query_construction (#eq? @_query_name "query"))
((call function: (attribute attribute: (identifier) @_xpath_api) arguments: (argument_list . (_) @xpath_argument)) @xpath_call (#match? @_xpath_api "^(XPath|xpath)$"))
((call function: (attribute object: (identifier) @_xpath_module attribute: (identifier) @_select_api) arguments: (argument_list . (_) . (_) @xpath_argument)) @xpath_call (#eq? @_xpath_module "elementpath") (#eq? @_select_api "select"))
((function_definition name: (identifier) @_post_name body: (block (expression_statement (augmented_assignment left: (identifier) @_response_name operator: "+=" right: (_) @body_expression) @body_construction) (return_statement (identifier) @_return_name) @body_return)) @body_handler (#match? @_post_name "_post$") (#eq? @_response_name "RESPONSE") (#eq? @_return_name "RESPONSE"))

rules.falsifier: A required endpoint is absent, ambiguous or incompletely parsed. Lexical captures do not establish API binding, data flow or a policy decision.

rules.title: Select XPath value guards and replacements

check.query:
(if_statement condition: (comparison_operator (string) @guard_literal operators: "in" (identifier) @guard_value) consequence: (block (return_statement))) @quote_guard
((call function: (attribute object: (_) @replacement_receiver attribute: (identifier) @_replace_name) arguments: (argument_list . (string) @replacement_from . (string) @replacement_to)) @quote_replacement (#eq? @_replace_name "replace"))

rules.falsifier: These lexical statements do not establish that a guard or replacement applies to the selected XPath argument; missing or ambiguous optional captures supply no inferred protection.

rules.title: Calculate selected Python strings before sink interpretation
rules.falsifier: The unique selected expression does not have a proved source-authored string value; unsupported paths remain unresolved, and this intermediate calculation does not decide sink origin.

rules.title: Path traversal: reachable filesystem operation

check.instructions: code is the complete init function registering this testcase's request handlers; support_parts supplies the pinned complete module, imports and helpers. During normal invocation of its registered POST handler, does a call access the filesystem using a pathname? Opening, reading, writing, deleting and querying filesystem metadata (such as Path.exists or stat) count. Constructing a path without accessing the filesystem does not. Assess this operation only; pathname origin and confinement are separate.
check.criteria_true: The invoked handler performs a filesystem operation using a pathname, including a metadata query.
check.criteria_false: The invoked handler performs no filesystem operation using a pathname.

rules.falsifier: A reachable handler path calls a file operation.

rules.title: Path traversal: request data reaches a file path

check.instructions: code is the complete init registering this testcase's handlers; support_parts supplies the pinned complete module, imports and helper definitions, named by path. For HTTP requests matched by the shown route registrations, can client-supplied content, including transformed or encoded content, become part of a path used by a reachable file operation? Resolve the reaching value after assignments, list mutation and indexing, immutable-string reassignment and feasible branches. A fixed component of a static route or request-dependent choice between fixed server constants does not count as client-supplied content. Assess path origin only; directory escape is separate. Missing decisive context remains uncertain.
check.criteria_true: Client-supplied content can become part of a path at a reachable file operation.
check.criteria_false: No client-supplied content reaches a file path at any reachable operation; request-dependent choice among fixed server values alone does not count.

rules.falsifier: Client-supplied content reaches a path at a reachable file operation.
